sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Setup and usage notes
sections.what: States that the harness runs in warn-only mode, gives the usage, and says it reads stored outputs. Imports the database, storage, slide builder, checker, extractors and types.
sections.why: Sets the expectation that nothing is blocked and that the numbers are read as they were shipped.
sections.watch_out: The header says the only write is one computation record per artifact, so confirm that after any change.

sections.name: arg, pct
sections.title: Flag and percentage helpers
sections.what: Reads a named command-line option with a default, and formats a fraction as a percentage.
sections.watch_out: The industry default of lithium-mining applies only where the code uses it, so check the option name when running.

sections.name: latestLessonsLearntRecipe
sections.title: Finding the latest lessons-learnt numbers
sections.what: Finds the most recent succeeded lessons-learnt run for an industry that has a deck stage, and returns its recipe, or nothing.
sections.why: Checks the numbers that were actually shown in the deck.
sections.watch_out: Only the newest run is checked, so older runs are not reviewed.

sections.name: latestRealityScanResult
sections.title: Finding the latest reality scan result
sections.what: Finds the most recent succeeded reality scan and reads its finalised result.
sections.why: Checks the numbers that the reality scan output contains.
sections.watch_out: Matches the finalize stage name exactly, so a renamed stage is skipped with only a message.

sections.name: printReport
sections.title: Printing one artifact report
sections.what: Prints total numbers emitted, counts and shares by class, the traceable rate against its threshold, untraceable causes, the worst labels, and which numbers would survive block mode.
sections.why: Shows how close each output is to the threshold.
sections.watch_out: The block-mode survivor list is an estimate, since nothing is actually blocked in this run.

sections.name: main (part 1)
sections.title: Checking each artifact
sections.what: Checks the lessons-learnt decks for lithium and gas-power, the reality scan result, and the slide set for the chosen industry, collecting a report for each. Stops with an error if the project fetch is incomplete.
sections.why: Covers all three output types in one run so their results can be compared.
sections.watch_out: The project fetch is capped at 100000 rows; if it is truncated, the run throws rather than checking part of the data.

sections.name: main: if
sections.title: Saving the report and counting records
sections.what: If a JSON path was given, writes the reports to that file. Then counts all computation records in the database and exits.
sections.why: Saves the results and shows how many checks are on file.
sections.watch_out: The count covers every computation record, not only this harness's rows, so the number can be misread.

summary: A measurement harness, in warn-only mode, that checks what share of the numbers in three outputs (a lessons-learnt deck, the reality scan result and the solar datum slide set) can be traced to a source or a calculation, and reports what would be blocked.
purpose: Show how traceable the numbers in the shipped outputs are, and what a stricter block mode would remove, without actually blocking anything.
why: The header says the harness is warn mode only, so it measures what shipped and leaves the outputs unchanged.
how: The script finds the latest succeeded lessons-learnt run for each of two industries and the latest reality scan result, reads the numbers from each, and checks them with the validator. It then loads the projects for the chosen industry, builds slide data, and checks those numbers too. For each artifact it prints counts by class, the traceable rate against a threshold, untraceable causes, worst labels and the survivors of block mode. Optionally it saves the reports to a JSON file, then counts all computation records.
inputs: A command-line industry option defaulting to lithium-mining, and a JSON output path. Database contents for runs, stages and projects.
outputs: A console report per artifact. An optional JSON file. One computation record per artifact is written by the validator, per the header.
risks: The extractors decide which numbers count, so a bad extractor misclassifies numbers and the rates are wrong. Nothing is enforced here, so the report is advice, not a gate.
debug: If a section is skipped, no succeeded run with the needed stage exists for it. If the rates look odd, check the extractor for that artifact. Year-like tokens are counted separately, so a year may appear as a number without being an error.
